newsitem.title: UK: Geberit International plans mark bond next week.
newsitem.headline: Geberit International plans mark bond next week.

text.p: Geberit International S.A. plans to launch a 157.5 million mark 10-year bond next week, syndicate managers said on Thursday.
Geberit International is a unit of Swiss company Geberit Beteilingungs AG, which was taken over in March by an investor group led by the London-based buyout fund Doughty Hanson.
The issue will be lead managed by Merrill Lynch, and bankers said the launch was likely next Thursday.

The deal, which was rated B2 by Moody's Investors Service and BB by Standard & Poor's, provides a rare chance for investors to buy high-yielding, sub-investment grade corporate debt in a European currency, bankers said.
"The market for high-yielding corporate debt is well-developed in the U.S., but not so much in Europe," a banker familiar with the transaction said.
"Geberit is already well-known among German and Swiss institutional investors, which is why they decided to go for marks rather than dollars to finance the recent acquisition," he said.
